steps.en: Add FPDI and one supported PDF writer to the PHP application
steps.zh: 把 FPDI 与一个受支持的 PDF writer 加入 PHP 应用

steps.en: Create the FPDI class and select a source page
steps.zh: 创建 FPDI 类并选择一个源页面

steps.en: Parses the page and imports its content as a reusable template
steps.zh: 解析页面，把内容导入为可复用模板

steps.en: Place the template and draw any new document content
steps.zh: 放置模板并绘制新的文档内容

steps.en: Writes the composed pages as a newly generated PDF
steps.zh: 把组合后的页面写成新生成的 PDF

value.en: Existing PDF pages become reusable building blocks in a PHP-generated document
value.zh: 现有 PDF 页面成为 PHP 生成文档中的可复用构件
